A spatula presses them down to extract flavor. Later, dried chilies and peppercorns are added to the hot oil and stirred vigorously. (6) [People: Hands only] [Objects: Final dish on black plate] [Setting: Wooden dining table] [Text: Logo overlay]. The completed stir-fry is carefully arranged on a black plate. The shot is a bright, eye-level close-up showing the textures of the crispy shrimp and shiny sauce, concluding the demonstration.

The narrator's speech rate is moderate, with natural pauses between instructions, while the guitar BGM continues its repetitive loop. A whoosh sound effect marks a transition between the adding of ingredients. (6) The BGM volume swells slightly as the narration concludes with a friendly sign-off. The final acoustic environment is clean studio silence behind the music and voice, resulting in a high signal-to-noise ratio overall.
